input.content: You are a senior PLC control systems architect. Return ONLY valid JSON.

You are a PLC control software architect. Produce a concise architecture plan (at most 2000 words). Do not enumerate exhaustive traces. Return complete JSON with keys:
- state_machine: list of states and transitions
- timer_plan: timers required, PT durations, reset conditions
- priorities: safety and operational priorities
- initial_values: initial values for variables
- scan_execution_order: explicit 4-stage scan order (1. edge sampling, 2. safety/reset priority & state transitions, 3. unconditional top-level timer FB calls outside CASE/IF, 4. unified output assignments)
- formal_assertions: optional list of {"id": "A1", "formula": "G(...)"} temporal/invariant assertions over declared VAR_INPUT/VAR_OUTPUT port names

SPECIFICATIONS:
{
  "id": "SELF007",
  "title": "Duty standby alternation with healthy pump fallback",
  "difficulty": "medium",
  "requirements": "# SELF007: Duty/Standby Dual-Pump Alternation with Fault Fallback\n\n## Background\nDual-pump (`PumpA`/`PumpB`) duty/standby alternator balancing wear across served demand episodes.\n\n## Functional Requirements\n1. Inputs: `Demand`, `FaultA`, `FaultB` (`BOOL`). Initial preference `LeadA := TRUE`, episode memory `served := FALSE`, `previous_demand := FALSE`.\n2. When `Demand = FALSE`: both `PumpA := FALSE`, `PumpB := FALSE`; if `previous_demand = TRUE AND served = TRUE`, toggle `LeadA := NOT LeadA`; reset `served := FALSE`.\n3. When `Demand = TRUE`: select the preferred lead pump (`PumpA` if `LeadA`, else `PumpB`) if healthy; otherwise fall back to the healthy standby pump; if both fault, run neither. If either pump runs on this scan, mark `served := TRUE`.\n4. `LeadA` reflects the post-transition preference; `previous_demand` tracks `I[k].Demand` on every scan.\n\n## Interface\n- **Inputs:** `Demand: BOOL`, `FaultA: BOOL`, `FaultB: BOOL`\n- **Outputs:** `PumpA: BOOL`, `PumpB: BOOL`, `LeadA: BOOL`\n\n## Initial Values\n- `LeadA=true`, `previous_demand=false`, `episode_served=false`, `PumpA=false`, `PumpB=false`\n\n## Timing & Evaluation Conventions\nIf `Demand` stays FALSE for multiple scans, alternation occurs at most once on the falling edge following a served demand episode.",
  "scenario": "Two sump pumps share wear by alternating the preferred pump only after a demand episode that actually delivered pumping.",
  "interface": [
    {
      "direction": "INPUT",
      "name": "Demand",
      "type": "BOOL",
      "description": "Sump pumping demand"
    },
    {
      "direction": "INPUT",
      "name": "FaultA",
      "type": "BOOL",
      "description": "Pump A unavailable"
    },
    {
      "direction": "INPUT",
      "name": "FaultB",
      "type": "BOOL",
      "description": "Pump B unavailable"
    },
    {
      "direction": "OUTPUT",
      "name": "PumpA",
      "type": "BOOL",
      "description": "Pump A run command"
    },
    {
      "direction": "OUTPUT",
      "name": "PumpB",
      "type": "BOOL",
      "description": "Pump B run command"
    },
    {
      "direction": "OUTPUT",
      "name": "LeadA",
      "type": "BOOL",
      "description": "TRUE selects A as preferred pump"
    }
  ],
  "initial_conditions": {
    "LeadA": true,
    "previous_demand": false,
    "episode_served": false,
    "PumpA": false,
    "PumpB": false
  },
  "scan_semantics": "At scan k, sample every input once, read retained pre-state q[k], execute one transition, and observe outputs O[k] at the end of that same scan. Updated state becomes q[k+1]. Reset the instance before each test. Step 0 executes normally; initial conditions describe pre-state, not an extra delayed scan. All timing in this task is explicitly counted in invocations, not wall time.",
  "safety_priority": [
    "Faulted pumps never run",
    "No demand forces both off",
    "Prefer selected lead, then healthy fallback"
  ],
  "assumptions": [
    "The task interface, requirements, assumptions, and normalized LTL definitions (excluding reference-only ground truth) are supplied identically to both frameworks. Output names always denote observed candidate outputs, never precomputed expected values.",
    "The task interface, requirements, assumptions, and normalized LTL definitions (excluding reference-only ground truth) are supplied identically to both frameworks. Output names always denote observed candidate outputs, never precomputed expected values."
  ],
  "atomic_propositions": {
    "Demand": "I[k].Demand: sampled input (BOOL).",
    "FaultA": "I[k].FaultA: sampled input (BOOL).",
    "FaultB": "I[k].FaultB: sampled input (BOOL).",
    "PumpA": "O[k].PumpA: independently observed post-scan candidate value (BOOL); never defined as expected output.",
    "PumpB": "O[k].PumpB: independently observed post-scan candidate value (BOOL); never defined as expected output.",
    "LeadA": "O[k].LeadA: independently observed post-scan candidate value (BOOL); never defined as expected output.",
    "first": "k=0; first invocation, not the pre-invocation observation",
    "qLeadA": "{\"kind\": \"previous_observed_output\", \"source\": \"O[k-1].LeadA\", \"initial\": true, \"update\": \"After comparing scan k, store ACTUAL O[k].LeadA; never write into reference state.\"}",
    "completedServed": "Spre.reference.state.demand AND NOT I[k].Demand AND Spre.reference.state.served",
    "init": "At the separate pre-invocation initial observation before scan k=0: O_init.PumpA=false, O_init.PumpB=false, O_init.LeadA=true."
  },
  "ltl": [
    {
      "id": "SELF007.P_init",
      "kind": "safety",
      "formula": "init",
      "description": "Before the first scan invocation, all declared OUTPUT variables and initial instance state hold their declared initial values.",
      "explanation": "Applies strictly to the fresh pre-invocation initial instance observation before scan k=0 (INITIAL_INSTANCE scope).",
      "language": "LTL_OVER_TYPED_SCAN_PREDICATES",
      "encoding_status": "NOT_LOWERED_TO_MODEL_CHECKER",
      "scope": "INITIAL_INSTANCE"
    },
    {
      "id": "SELF007.P1",
      "formula": "G(!(PumpA & PumpB))",
      "explanation": "At most one pump runs.",
      "language": "LTL_OVER_TYPED_SCAN_PREDICATES",
      "encoding_status": "NOT_LOWERED_TO_MODEL_CHECKER",
      "scope": "SCAN_SEQUENCE"
    },
    {
      "id": "SELF007.P2",
      "formula": "G((!Demand | FaultA) -> !PumpA)",
      "explanation": "A cannot run without demand or with its fault.",
      "language": "LTL_OVER_TYPED_SCAN_PREDICATES",
      "encoding_status": "NOT_LOWERED_TO_MODEL_CHECKER",
      "scope": "SCAN_SEQUENCE"
    },
    {
      "id": "SELF007.P3",
      "formula": "G((!Demand | FaultB) -> !PumpB)",
      "explanation": "B cannot run without demand or with its fault.",
      "language": "LTL_OVER_TYPED_SCAN_PREDICATES",
      "encoding_status": "NOT_LOWERED_TO_MODEL_CHECKER",
      "scope": "SCAN_SEQUENCE"
    },
    {
      "id": "SELF007.P4",
      "formula": "G((Demand & LeadA & !FaultA) -> PumpA)",
      "explanation": "A is selected when it is the healthy lead.",
      "language": "LTL_OVER_TYPED_SCAN_PREDICATES",
      "encoding_status": "NOT_LOWERED_TO_MODEL_CHECKER",
      "scope": "SCAN_SEQUENCE"
    },
    {
      "id": "SELF007.P5",
      "formula": "G((Demand & !LeadA & !FaultB) -> PumpB)",
      "explanation": "B is selected when it is the healthy lead.",
      "language": "LTL_OVER_TYPED_SCAN_PREDICATES",
      "encoding_status": "NOT_LOWERED_TO_MODEL_CHECKER",
      "scope": "SCAN_SEQUENCE"
    },
    {
      "id": "SELF007.P6",
      "formula": "G(completedServed -> (LeadA <-> !qLeadA))",
      "explanation": "Toggle once on a served demand's falling edge.",
      "language": "LTL_OVER_TYPED_SCAN_PREDICATES",
      "encoding_status": "NOT_LOWERED_TO_MODEL_CHECKER",
      "scope": "SCAN_SEQUENCE"
    },
    {
      "id": "SELF007.P7",
      "formula": "G(!completedServed -> (LeadA <-> qLeadA))",
      "explanation": "Unserved episodes and held demand preserve preference.",
      "language": "LTL_OVER_TYPED_SCAN_PREDICATES",
      "encoding_status": "NOT_LOWERED_TO_MODEL_CHECKER",
      "scope": "SCAN_SEQUENCE"
    },
    {
      "id": "SELF007.P8",
      "formula": "G((Demand & FaultA & !FaultB) -> PumpB)",
      "explanation": "Explicit correction of a demonstrated omission.",
      "language": "LTL_OVER_TYPED_SCAN_PREDICATES",
      "encoding_status": "NOT_LOWERED_TO_MODEL_CHECKER",
      "scope": "SCAN_SEQUENCE"
    },
    {
      "id": "SELF007.P9",
      "formula": "G((Demand & FaultB & !FaultA) -> PumpA)",
      "explanation": "Explicit correction of a demonstrated omission.",
      "language": "LTL_OVER_TYPED_SCAN_PREDICATES",
      "encoding_status": "NOT_LOWERED_TO_MODEL_CHECKER",
      "scope": "SCAN_SEQUENCE"
    }
  ]
}
